subject: English Home Language

source.topic: This is where people live: Emergent Reading and Phonics
source.subtopic: Phonics: identifies the 'd' sound at the beginning of words (door, desk, dog, donkey)

show.line: Listen. d as in door. d, d, door. Knock on the door. d, d, dog!

rounds.prompt: Which one starts with d, as in door?
Say the sound with me. d, as in door!

rounds.story: Dumisani opens the door. His dog runs in and sits under the desk. Where does the dog sit?

rounds.prompt: Which animal starts with d? d, d.
What is this? It starts with d.
Does it start with d? Put d words in the d group.

hints: Listen for d at the start. d, d, door.
Tap your tongue behind your teeth. d, d.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will find a word that starts with d.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Cat starts with c. Door starts with d.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's listen together. d, d, door. Door starts with d!

parent_line: Can hear the d sound at the start of words.
